description: Cross-modality pair (email + RSS) of the same TLDR AI issue, both 528 words but diverging at the tail — the email variant ends on 'Do Agent Teams Pay Off?', the RSS variant ends on 'What is Speculative Decoding?'. The shared lead story (Nvidia discussing boosting its Reflection AI investment / offering compute, possibly leading to acquisition) must merge into one item citing both sources. Revised 2026-10-27: every run (Sonnet high/xhigh, Opus) classified this as development_type 'funding', not 'm&a' — a defensible read, since the capture describes early-stage investment talks, not a closed acquisition (meta/taxonomy.md: funding = priced round/grant/debt, m&a = acquisition/merger/acquihire). The original assertion was too narrow; the real thing worth checking is correct merging and entity extraction, not pinning one disputable taxonomy value.
